references.context: Module theory over a commutative unital ring R: ideal action IM on an R-module M, the R-submodule generated by all finite sums of products i*m with i∈I and m∈M; this includes (I^n)M for ideal powers I^n, but differs from ideal multiplication I^n alone and from forming a quotient module M/I^nM.
references.matching_note: The submodule (I^n)M comes from the action of the nth ideal power on M; it is not the ideal I^n itself nor the quotient M/I^nM.
